title: TIAM - A Metric for Evaluating Alignment in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the generation occurrence rates of specific objects based on their sequential position (e.g., first, second, third, or fourth) within the text prompt templates.

Generating multiple images per prompt using different initial Gaussian noise seeds and calculating alignment scores to quantify the systematic performance disparity between 'good' and 'bad' starting seeds.

Evaluating the success rate of generating two distinct objects in the same image and correlating this alignment score with the semantic distance (e.g., Wu-Palmer distance, CLIPscore) between the objects to determine if closely related objects are harder to generate together.
